ussakkati.p: [U+sakka+a+ti] (kri) Google Translate (1) It rises in stages; He does the whole moon; (2) He approaches.
a: ဥဿက္ကတိ(ကြိ)

H: ussakkati：① [ud-sṛp] （兩手兩膝貼在地面）爬行上去，上升．② = ussukkati 努力．caus．ussakkāpeti．
S: ussakkati：① [ud-sṛp] はい上る，上る．② = ussukkati 努力する．caus．ussakkāpeti．
F: Ussakkati，1 （ud + sakkati，see sakkati） to creep out or up to，to rise．ussakkitvā﹐【独】。
B:
ussakkati： ussakkati（kri）

P: Ussakkati，<sup>2</sup> [by-form of ussukkati] to endeavour Vism．437； VvA．95 （Caus．II．ussakkāpesi），214．（Page 156）
Ussakkati，<sup>1</sup> [ud + sakkati，see sakkati] to creep out or up to，to rise A．III，241 sq； Miln．260．（Page 156）

DOP: ussakkati ussukkati ( prob. by influence of ussukka qv, but possibly denom. from ussukka), pr. 3 sg. [ud + sakkati], moves up, rises; moves forward, advances, progresses ; D I 230, 21 (osakkantiyā vā ~eyya paraṃmukhiṃ vā āliṅgeyya, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ussukkeyya; Sv 397, 16 : paṭikkamantiyā upagaccheyya anicchantiyā iccheyya); Mil 260, 25 (udakaṃ … gagane ~atī ti); Vism 705, 12 (yo hi samathavasen’ eva ~ati); Th-a I 179, 23 (uppate ti … ussukkeyya, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce ukkaṃseyya); Vibh-a 419, 29 (~ituṃ paccayo na hoti); — part.pr. ( a ) ussakkanta, ussukkanta, mfn. , Sv 397, 24 (~anto, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ussukkanto); Ud-a 398, 11 (ussukkantassa, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ussukkāpentassa); ( b ) ussukkamāna, mfn. , Vism 153, 15 (so appaguṇe jhāne ussukkamāno); — absol. ussakkitvā, A III 241, 7 (kimī … pādehi ~itvā yāva jānumaṇḍalā paṭicchādesuṃ); Mil 260, 22 (mahāsamudde udakaṃ … ~itvā velāya paharati); Vism 437, 5 (~itvā pana maggapātubhāvaṃ pāpetuṃ na sakkoti); Vv-a 214, 12 (dānakathaṃ ādiṃ katvā ~itvā nekkhamme ānisaṃsavibhāvanavasena pavattitaṃ); — caus. ( a ) pp ussakkita , ussukkita, mfn. , advanced, furthered ; Sv 725, 7 (ussukkitā me vipassanā ti) = Spk III 83, 11 ( Be, Se so; Ce ~ā; Ee wr ussukitā); — caus. ( b ) 3 sg. ussakkāpeti and, more usually, ussukkāpeti ( prob. by influence of ussukka qv, but possibly denom. from ussukka), causes to move forward, to progress; furthers ; Sv 725, 7 (vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā ussukkāpetuṃ sakkontassa ussukkitā me vipassanā ti somanassajātassa); It-a I 116, 23 (nibbindati virajjati vipassanaṃ ussukkāpeti); — part.pr. ussukkāpenta, mf (~entī) n. , It-a I 174, 17 (ussukkāpentā); Vv-a 98, 11 (ussukkāpentī); — aor. 1 sg. ussakkāpesiṃ, ussukkāpesiṃ, Vv-a 95, 12 (vipassanaṃ ~esin ti, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se ussukkāpesin ti); Th-a II 270, 36 (ussukkāpesiṃ); — absol. ussukkāpetvā, Spk II 175, 11 (tā ussukkāpetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathāpessāmī ti yācati); Ud-a 121, 21 (catusaccakammaṭṭhānabhāvanaṃ ussukkāpetvā); Vv-a 95, 13 (vipassanaṃ ussukkāpetvā); Thī-a 5, 23 (vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā anukkamena ussukkāpetvā); — pp ussukkāpita, mfn. , furthered ; Th-a III 161, 15 (vipassanā ussukkāpitā); — fpp ussukkāpetabba, ( mf ) n. impers. , Paṭis-a 19, 21 (yāva ariyamaggo tāva ussukkāpetabban ti).
CPD: 2 ussakkati and ussukkati , pr. 3 sg. ( denom. from ussukka; cf. Geiger § 188.1), to endeavour, strive, be eager, desire, long for ( loc ); seyyathā pi nāma ossak- kantiyā vā ~ eyya parammukhiṃ vā āliṅgeyya, D l 230, 21 ( Be 1956 so ; Ee text and ct. ussu-; = paṭikka- mantiyā upagaccheyya, anicchantiyā iccheyya, ekāya sampayogaṃ anicchantiyā eko iccheyya ti vuttaṃ hoti, Sv 397, 15 ); appaguṇe jhāne ~ amāno, Vism 153, 15 (us- su-); viññāṇaṃ . . . ~ itvā pana magga-pātubhāvaṃ pā- petuṃ na sakkoti, Vism 437, 5 (= udayabbaya-ñāṇa- paṭipātiyā āyūhitvā, mhṭ) ≠ Abhidh-av 112, 18* ( Be 1962 so ; Ee ~ etvā; = uddhaṃ sakkaṃ katvā, pṭ); cf. (= uk- kaṃsaṃ patvā, mhṭ); yathā taṇhā-diṭṭhi-gāhā ( so read ) na ppavattanti, tathā vīthi-paṭipannāya vipassanāya taṃ ~ antassa passaddhī ti, Ud-a 398, 11 ( Be 1958 so ; Ee ussu-); sabbaṃ etaṃ dāna-kathaṃ ādiṃ katvā ~ itvā, Vv-a 214, 12 ; Buddha-bhāvassa ~ itvā sampahaṃsanayog- gaṃ viriyaṃ, Cp-a 319, 23 ; — pp. ~ ita, Spk lll 83, 11 (ussu-); caus. ussukkāpeti q.v. 2 ussakkati
